body.message:
Hello! I previously contacted you about the alarm system that has been going off almost every day.

For the past two nights, the gas alarm has been going off at around 3 a.m. and again at 5 a.m. while I’m sleeping. There is no gas being used or anything unusual happening, so I believe there may be an issue with the alarm itself.

Could you please arrange for someone to come and check the system and fix the problem? It’s becoming very difficult to sleep with the alarm going off during the night.

I would really appreciate it if this could be checked as soon as possible.
